data.one_liner: dart:io adapter for Relic web server.
data.what_it_does: Provides a dart:io adapter for the Relic web server framework, allowing developers to run Relic apps using standard Dart I/O.
use_when: You are building a backend web service or API in Dart using the Relic framework with dart:io.
You want a modern, high-performance web server framework alternative to Shelf.
avoid_when: You are building client-side Flutter applications that only consume APIs.
You are using a different web framework such as Shelf.
strengths: Integrates seamlessly with the Relic web server framework.
Strongly typed APIs and built-in trie-based router support.
weaknesses: Niche ecosystem compared to older packages like shelf.
data.setup_notes: Add relic and relic_io to your dependencies and initialize in your main function.
